findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document with `self.repo.get(doc_id)` instead of `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`, so there is no ownership check and any authenticated user can rename another user's document (IDOR).
Because `rename` bypasses `_owned`, the NotFound-for-foreign-documents behavior is lost, so ids can be probed: a missing id raises NotFound but a foreign id succeeds.
In `rename`, validation runs before the ownership check; moving the `_owned` call first would keep error behavior consistent with the other methods.
